locations.note: Investigate cases across a stylized 1848 Paris, as the cases build up to the end of Louis-Philippe's reign and the start of the Second Republic.
The Louvre is the scene of the assassination attempt on the king, with the Salle du Tibre, the Grande Galerie and the gardens.
The king is found at the Palais-Royal in the final case.
A protest forms on the Place de la Concorde in the final case.
The final trial is held at the Palais de Justice.
A trial is held in the catacombs.
